description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Holy], [Awoken Holy], [Damage Cap +10000] and [New Red Wings Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Holy
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Holy damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Holy resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Holy
description.text: Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: New Red Wings Mode
description.text: Critical chance =100%, Holy attacks deal 50% more damage, instant cast speed
